<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*The world's largest airport, [[Beijing Daxing International Airport]], formally opens to commercial flights. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/daxing-international-airport-beijing-opens/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Ambon earthquake]]
**A 6.5-magnitude earthquake strikes the [[Maluku Islands]] in eastern [[Indonesia]]. 30 people are killed and 156 others injured. [https://www.rappler.com/world/regions/asia-pacific/241324-indonesia-earthquake-death-toll-september-29-2019 (Rappler)]
*Around 100 people are evacuated from Breivika port in [[Tromsø]], [[Norway]], after [[Russia]]n trawler [[ship prefix|FV]] ''Bukhta Naezdnik'' catches fire and develops a heavy list. The burning ship has a tank of [[ammonia]] and 200,000 litres of [[diesel oil]] on board. The ship is purposely capsized to reduce the risk of the ammonia tank exploding. [https://www.breakingnews.ie/world/explosion-risk-as-russian-trawler-catches-fire-in-norwegian-harbour-953159.html (BreakingNews.ie)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ship-fire-trawler-tromso-breivika-explosion-evacuation-a9121606.html (''The Independent'')]
*At least 30 miners are killed after a [[gold mine]] collapses due to a landslide in the [[Tibesti Region]], [[Chad]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-49839574 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Sudan]], Aftermath of the [[Sudanese Revolution]]
**[[Sudan]] closes its borders with [[Libya]] and the [[Central African Republic]] citing the "threat they pose to the security and [[economy of Sudan]]". [https://www.africanews.com/2019/09/26/sudan-will-close-its-borders-with-libya-and-central-africa-official/ (Africanews)]
*[[Japan–South Korea relations]], [[2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute]]
**Japan and South Korea fail to make progress toward resolution, but agree to continue dialogue. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/09/27/national/politics-diplomacy/although-pressing-disputes-remain-unresolved-japan-south-korea-agree-continue-dialogue/#.XY5JZ3GyTMx (''The Japan Times'')] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-27/south-korea-s-kang-says-big-disagreements-with-japan-persist (Bloomberg)]

;Law and crime
*The Major Criminal Court in [[Bahrain]] sentences four people to jail terms for setting up a terror group with the aim of launching attacks on police, and related crimes. Two are fugitives [[trial in absentia|tried ''in absentia'']] [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/bahrain/bahrain-convicts-four-on-terror-charges-1.66693197 (Gulf News)]
*Authorities in the [[Netherlands]] launch a probe into bank [[ABN Amro]]. The bank is suspected of breaching rules on [[money laundering]] and terrorism financing. [https://www.cityam.com/dutch-bank-abn-amro-probed-under-terror-financing-rules/ (City A.M.)]

;Politics and elections
*[[National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes to end [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump|Donald Trump's]] emergency declaration along the [[Mexico–United States border|U.S.-Mexico border]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/senate-votes-to-kill-national-emergency-declaration-along-southern-border (CBS News)]
*[[September 2019 Indonesian protests and riots]]
**A student dies after allegedly being shot during a violent clash between the protesters and police force in front of the provincial parliament building in [[Kendari]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2019/09/26/one-student-dies-one-in-critical-condition-after-protest-turns-violent-in-kendari.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[Soyuz-MS]] spacecraft ''[[Soyuz MS-15|Sarmat]]'' successfully docks with the [[International Space Station]], with the first [[Emiratis|Emirati]] astronaut, [[Hazza Al Mansouri]], and [[Expedition 61]] astronauts [[Jessica Meir]] and [[Oleg Skripochka]] joining the crew of [[Expedition 60]] aboard the station. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/science/uae-in-space-what-did-hazzaa-almansoori-carry-with-him-to-space-1.1569476103518 (''Gulf News'')]
